name: lantern
description: Your project is the whole context for your AI. Lantern maps it, helps you plan changes, reviews pull requests with generated flows, and keeps your AI assistant sessions together.

scripts.test:lsp: pnpm compile && vitest run test/lsp-integration.test.ts test/semantic-highlight.test.ts
scripts.test:graph:e2e: playwright test test/e2e/graph-regression.spec.ts test/e2e/graph-pixi.spec.ts test/e2e/graph-navigation.spec.ts test/e2e/pane-overflow.spec.ts
scripts.test:graph:macro:e2e: playwright test test/e2e/graph-macro.spec.ts test/e2e/graph-macro-areas.spec.ts test/e2e/graph-macro-foundation.spec.ts test/e2e/graph-macro-legend.spec.ts test/e2e/graph-macro-platform-uses.spec.ts test/e2e/graph-macro-systems.spec.ts test/e2e/graph-macroview.spec.ts
scripts.test:pr-review:e2e: playwright test test/e2e/pr-review-comments.spec.ts test/e2e/pr-review-demo.spec.ts test/e2e/pr-review-explain.spec.ts test/e2e/pr-review-layout.spec.ts test/e2e/pr-review-regions.spec.ts
scripts.start: node scripts/esbuild.mjs && LANTERN_PROFILE=dev env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron out
scripts.build: node scripts/esbuild.mjs --target-platform darwin --target-arch arm64 && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-packager out "Lantern" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --app-bundle-id=com.mobilereality.lantern --icon=build/icon.icns --extend-info=build/extend-info.plist --ignore='^/lsp-runtime($|/)' --ignore='^/cli($|/)' --ignore='^/licenses($|/)' --extra-resource=out/lsp-runtime --extra-resource=out/cli --extra-resource=out/licenses && node scripts/package-licences.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm run fuses && pnpm run sign
scripts.dist:share: pnpm run build && pnpm run fuses && pnpm run sign:adhoc && pnpm run pack
scripts.build:win: node scripts/esbuild.mjs --target-platform win32 --target-arch x64 && electron-packager out "Lantern" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --app-bundle-id=com.mobilereality.lantern --icon=build/icon.ico --ignore="^/lsp-runtime($|/)" --ignore="^/cli($|/)" --ignore="^/licenses($|/)" --extra-resource=out/lsp-runtime --extra-resource=out/cli --extra-resource=out/licenses && node scripts/package-licences.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && pnpm run fuses
scripts.build:linux: node scripts/esbuild.mjs --target-platform linux --target-arch x64 && electron-packager out "Lantern" --platform=linux --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --app-bundle-id=com.mobilereality.lantern --icon=build/icon.png --ignore="^/lsp-runtime($|/)" --ignore="^/cli($|/)" --ignore="^/licenses($|/)" --extra-resource=out/lsp-runtime --extra-resource=out/cli --extra-resource=out/licenses && node scripts/package-licences.mjs --platform linux --arch x64 && pnpm run fuses
